sub_answers.text: Frans Dove is often credited with introducing lawn tennis to the Gold Coast and he, alongside his brothers, represented the Gold Coast in both cricket and tennis and founded the early inter-colonial matches against Nigeria [d80508735s3p0]. The inter-colonial cricket and tennis competitions that Dove founded were initially between the Gold Coast and Nigeria and later extended to include Sierra Leone and The Gambia [d80508735s3p0]. Dove’s home, the grand Tutu House in Tudu, Accra, became a social and athletic hub that hosted prestigious annual tournaments in the region [d80508735s3p0].
